item.title: 我用来捕获交易欺诈的 SQL 模式
item.description:
📝 AND order_tx AS ( SELECT cardholder_id, timestamp, location, LAG(timestamp) OVER (PARTITION BY cardholder_id ORDER BY timestamp) AS prev_ts, LAG(location) OVER (PARTITION BY cardholder_id ORDER BY timestamp) AS prev_loc FROM transactions ) SELECT cardholder_id, prev_ts AS first_tx, timestamp AS secondary_tx, prev_loc AS first_location,位置 AS secondary_location, EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (timestamp - prev_ts)) / 60 AS 分钟_apart, hasrsine(prev_loc, location) ASmiles_apart FROM Ordered_tx WHERE prev_ts IS NOT NULL AND prev_loc <> location AND hasrsine(prev_loc, location) / nullif(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (timestamp - prev_ts)), 0) * 3600 > 600;半正矢是大圆距离函数。 SELECT cardholder_id、timestamp、amount、merchant_id FROM transactions WHERE（金额 >= 99。略低于阈值的金额是不同的。
🔤 Original: SQL patterns I use to catch transaction fraud
🔗 Read more: https://analytics.fixelsmith.com/posts/sql-fraud-patterns/

item.title: 《纽约时报》和 Vaping：如何通过只说真实的话来撒谎 (2022)
item.description:
📝 本文着眼于 2022 年《纽约时报》一篇关于青少年电子烟的文章，该文章将合成尼古丁、调味电子烟、莉齐·伯吉斯的住院治疗和尼古丁成瘾并置，但没有明确指出合法调味尼古丁电子烟导致了她的肺损伤。 2019 年尼古丁电子烟道德恐慌是我们这个时代最引人注目的恐慌之一，非法黑市 THC 大麻电子烟中含有维生素 E 醋酸酯中毒，导致严重的“EVALI”肺损伤，这是史无前例地禁止合法尼古丁电子烟产品的主要理由。这应该说得更清楚。
🔤 Original: NYT and Vaping: How to Lie by Saying Only True Things (2022)
🔗 Read more: https://gwern.net/vaping

item.title: Orthrus-Qwen3：Qwen3 上高达 7.8×tokens/forward，相同的输出分布
item.description:
